title: FarEye helps reduce e-commerce major Flipkart logistics expenses by 6%
description:
AI-powered enterprise SaaS Far Eye on Sunday said it has helped e-commerce major Flipkart's B2B cash-and-carry market place, Flipkart Wholesale, slash its logistics spend by 6 per cent besides an 8 per cent reduction in vehicle deployment pan-India.
This has enabled Flipkart Wholesale to improve fleet productivity without compromising delivery efficiency, reducing vehicle idle time by 10 per cent, Far Eye said in a statement.
The improvements come from digitising and connecting dispatch, routing, compliance and payment collection processes across a network comprising 26 stores and one cross-dock, it said.
Flipkart Wholesale's network processes more than 200,000 orders and about 195,000 vehicle assignments a month.
The platform said it now supports the movement of goods across this network through a unified digital workflow, replacing largely manual and fragmented dispatch processes.
